CONVERSATION TITLE: ERP vs PLM: What is the difference?
CONTENT:
Dear Muhammad,

 

Many OEM/ODM business and fashion retailers often ask what the difference between ERP and PLM is.


How do we decide which technology is the better investment and will have a greater ROI? We would like to help you understand these terms better.

 

To put it simply, ERP manages many of the ‘back office’ aspects of business transactions such as issuing purchase orders or tracking inventory.


PLM includes all of the iterative and creative processes that make up the elements of a product’s lifecycle and delivers a competitive advantage that ERP cannot. ERP is limited without PLM, but they work well in tandem.
